rewrites_catalogue.instructions: This script writes a whole String Catalogue (.xcstrings) back out by serialising it from memory.

criteria.true: It parses a .xcstrings file into a data structure and then writes the entire structure back to that file, for example with a JSON dump
criteria.false: It only reads the catalogue, edits the file in place without reserialising it, delegates to Apple's own tooling, or does not touch a .xcstrings at all
